name: Alchemical Reaction
source:
Alchemical Reaction is an LGBT-friendly dating sim about an up-and-coming alchemist trying to make a life for themselves in a new town. 

[Edited  from [url=https://teamcerberus.itch.io/alchemical-reaction-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Alchemical Reaction》是一款LGBT友好的约会模拟游戏，讲述了一位崭露头角的炼金术士试图在新城镇谋生的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://teamcerberus.itch.io/alchemical-reaction-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
